method.class: Budget-stratified repeated-run reliability audit of genuine interventional Kernel SHAP on frozen tabular classifiers
method.description: Determine, rather than presume, when one randomized Kernel SHAP explanation is reproducible and reference-consistent for German Credit and ACSIncome, logistic regression and random forests, and explicitly bounded explanation budgets. Hold the fitted model, explained instance, background, feature grouping, output scale, and missing-feature semantics fixed while varying explainer randomness; distinguish this variation from model-training and background sensitivity. Compare one-shot explanations with independent repetitions, matched-total-budget multi-start averaging, and evaluator-owned exact or higher-budget references. Report top-three membership, signed attribution agreement, numerical error, and uncertainty jointly: stable but incorrect explanations are not reliable. Any assertion of sufficient reliability must use a preregistered practical agreement tolerance and confidence criterion, not merely a favorable mean; these publication criteria never become comparative search eligibility thresholds. Negative and inconclusive findings are valid outcomes. Claims are restricted to tested populations, models, budgets, and interventional probability-scale explanations, not causal faithfulness, clinical suitability, conditional SHAP, all SHAP algorithms, or universal deployment safety. No improvement over a baseline is assumed or required. Frozen complete maximum-size operation table: search empirical (8 primary + 1 replay) each reset=1, model_start=1, model_chunk=16, model_commit=1, explain=8, total=27; controls (2 episodes) each reset=1, model_start=3, model_chunk=48, model_commit=3, explain=6, total=61; search=9*27+2*61=365. Final empirical (12 primary + 1 replay) each reset=1, model_start=1, model_chunk=16, model_commit=1, explain=18, total=37; controls (3 episodes) each total=61; final=13*37+3*61=664. These caps use declared maximum 16 chunks per 16 MiB in-memory JSON model, including start and commit for even one chunk. No state exports, training RPCs, rollouts, external filesystem transfers or additional replay exist. Smoke has 4 empirical primary + 1 replay, each reset=1, model_start=1, model_chunk<=16, model_commit=1, explain=2, and one complete control-suite episode; 5*21+61=166 maximum calls, 6 resets. No retries. Preflight serializes full compact UTF-8 JSON lines, base64 payloads, dtype/shape/content-type/digests, representative maximum-depth 64-tree model, maximum queries/responses, and 64 KiB envelope/framing reserve. Each complete message is strictly below application 2 MiB and harness 64 MiB. Raw chunks<=1 MiB; assembly<=16 MiB, one outstanding upload, transfer/cache<=64 MiB. The runtime preflight and draft maximum upload test include all setup/chunk/commit calls. Frozen metric formulas: per vector reference_fidelity=1/(1+L1(candidate-reference)/max(L1(reference),0.001)); efficiency_error=min(1,abs(sum(phi)-(f(x)-mean_background(f)))/max(abs(f(x)-mean_background(f)),0.001)). Top-three uses descending absolute value with feature-index ties, overlap=intersection/min(3,d). Signs use absolute zero tolerance 1e-8. top3_overlap and signed_agreement each average (weight 1/2) reference agreement and mean all unordered repeated-run pairs within each instance-budget cell. Within each empirical case average repetitions equally, instances equally, budgets equally; then statistical seeds equally, models equally within dataset, datasets equally. Equal full Cartesian coverage permits a flat mean of equal-size empirical episodes. Search instances=8/background=16/repetitions=4/budgets=[64,256]; final instances=16/background=16/repetitions=6/budgets=[64,256,1024]. Control suite equally weights constant/copy/permuted_input/additive (1/4 each), then seeds equally. Search combined_score=0.8*empirical reference_fidelity+0.2*control_pass_rate. Final has no optimization score. Replay is a diagnostic only, weight zero in primary metrics. replay_error=min(1,max absolute attribution difference of first full empirical episode and its one trailing replay)); must be<=1e-10 for correctness. Missing vector cells keep fidelity/overlap/sign=0 and efficiency_error=1 at their fixed weights; missing controls=0, replay_error=1. Failed_fraction counts failed primary episodes /10 search or /15 final. Every whole-case failure retains all its planned cells; partial completed cells remain at original weights. Incomplete work has wall_seconds equal to its plane ceiling; evidence duration_seconds retains measured actual elapsed work, not a productive-work claim. Per-episode evidence includes real baseline vectors, reference discrepancies, productive method durations, evaluator-counted prediction rows, and a 1000-draw instance-clustered 95% percentile bootstrap of fidelity. This bootstrap alone is not full hierarchical inference or a reference error guarantee; dependent repeat pairs are never independent replicates. Complete vectors support downstream paired and hierarchical analysis. Evaluator-owned validity checks use exact finite JSON schemas, original-group dimensions, prediction serialization equivalence, available genuine shap.KernelExplainer baselines with l1_reg=0 and identity link, exact ACS and analytic references, two independent 4096-coalition German references, immutable content-disjoint manifests, analytic fixtures, nonvacuous coordinate permutation, copy rejection, and full reset replay. No candidate-reported flag, state hash, timing, method name, counter or claim of learning determines validity. Scientific correctness does not demand high empirical reliability or baseline superiority. search.correct is complete fixed search coverage including required baselines, shape/finite wire validity, all analytic controls within 1e-7, replay within 1e-10 and operational integrity. Search eligibility is exactly search.correct=true, with no comparative score threshold. final.correct independently applies the same evidence-completeness/analytic/integrity gates to sealed final coverage; it does not automatically certify a publication claim. Frozen-source identity and actual-method review are harness/author evidence obligations, not proven by black-box comparisons; the evaluator does not inspect untrusted source or silently treat self-reports as source authentication. No feedback-adaptivity/learning gate is applicable to this fixed-model explanation task. Negative or inconclusive empirical results are valid if these checks complete. A failed required control leaves its finite penalty and makes operational qualification infeasible; remaining scheduled resets are still dispatched. Offline CPU-only Linux x86_64, glibc>=2.28, CPython 3.12 tested (design 3.11 refined to the actual available portable runtime). Aggregate 3 logical CPUs/12 GiB: evaluator 1 CPU/8 GiB, candidate 2 CPUs/4 GiB, no GPUs. BLAS/OpenMP/estimator pools bounded to role allowance. Native candidates use TASK_PYTHON or sys.executable only if unset, a fresh explicit environment, private temporary code copy, Linux Landlock filesystem confinement, seccomp network/fork/exec restrictions, process-group kill/reap, RLIMIT_AS=4 GiB and RLIMIT_CPU=wall*effective allowed CPUs. Production uses the exact in-process trusted /broker-code/candidate_proxy.py plus socket two-signal check; it is never relaunched or sandboxed by the evaluator. One invocation-wide monotonic deadline subtracts conservative broker/container startup (search 300 s, final 600 s) and reserves 90 s finalization, global remaining-reset slots (5 s reset +6 s episode overhead), and bounded baseline/candidate cleanup including stderr drain. Before each empirical/control method group reserve five equal productive-method allowances: training, reference, standard SHAP, matched two-start average and candidate; each search allowance=50 s, final=110 s; trusted baseline worker enforces four sequential stage allowances plus bounded import/setup, candidate calls enforce the remaining method deadline. Baselines and candidate have equal requested coalition allocations and per-method wall allowances; requested candidate inner work is advisory, not an externally enforced operation count. Joint conservative preflight requires search 3261 s and final 9666 s (each includes all declared episodes, startup, reset, method work/cleanup and finish) within ceilings 3600/10800. Smoke changes shapes only: 64 training rows,4 trees,2 queries,4 backgrounds,2 repeats,budget16; same loaders/imports/transport/control/aggregation path, 120 s total with 5 s startup and 5 s finish. Smoke does not establish ordinary production feasibility; qualification.feasible is true only for ordinary completed workloads. No canonical minimum productive baseline duration or comparative calibration delegation exists; none is invented. Dependencies and compatible binary wheels were checked in temporary draft venv, not user/global environment. Wrapper owns canonical venv and sanitized offline bootstrap; no live install or download occurs during evaluation. Explicit data refinement: ACS 2024 contains RELSHIPP, not the RELP field named in supplied folktables commit. Use native RELSHIPP as the relationship feature group and label experiments ACSIncome-2024-RELSHIPP. Other nine predictors, adult population filter and PINCP>50000 target follow inspected folktables ACSIncome. No fabricated old-code crosswalk or different dataset is substituted. German/ACS categorical or coded scalar predictors use training-only ordinal representation, median imputation and scaling; not one-hot features and not an optimal predictive-model claim. Logistic lbfgs is deterministic given fixed data; its statistical seeds vary explainer randomness, not fictitious independent fitted models. Forest seeds vary training. Raw normalization precedes population filtering, split/group selection and encoding: typed canonical Decimal numeric values, null sentinel, categorical NFKC and collapsed whitespace; exclude IDs/labels from predictor-content hash and retain full-record hashes/provenance separately. Jointly exclude 3883 CA/NY raw-content overlap groups, split German content groups 50:50, then all datasets 60:20:20; freeze raw rows, source IDs, row positions, conflict audits and deterministic split salts. The scaffold is an operational benchmark, not a finished conference paper. Full production completion, independent method/source review, reference interpretation, newest official template/page/checklist compliance, literature review and plot/table generation remain required downstream. No prohibited prior work was searched or identified; only the explicitly permitted 2017 starter abstract, SHAP implementation, folktables source and canonical data/policy/variable metadata were inspected. Interrupted evidence stores reference-vector and unordered-repeat-pair observations separately from initialization; agreement always retains one-half reference weight and one-half pair weight, dividing by the full planned repetition and pair denominators, with missing observations zero. The same formula applies to complete episodes. Preflight checks every interruption position for two, four and six repetitions. Every explain request additionally carries workload={usable_seconds,remaining_explanations}: positive remaining shared candidate-method wall seconds including transport and remaining uploads, and the number of scheduled explanation calls including the current call. These seed-independent runtime hints use the same fields in smoke, empirical, replay and analytic-control calls, expose no private answers or scores, and allow candidates to adapt to larger final batches/call counts without increasing any deadline, changing coalition budgets or reducing fixed coverage. Fatal TransportFailure is recorded with its fixed category and propagates after bounded cleanup to the nonzero operational-failure path; only recoverable failures on a usable broker continue scheduled resets. Already validated cells and pairs retain their original weights on operational failure; missing evidence keeps finite worst cases and correctness/qualification are false.

search_proxies.name: reduced_repeated_run_audit
search_proxies.preserves: Both actual public datasets, two frozen model families, interventional original-group identity-link semantics, real Kernel SHAP baselines, independent repeats, finite failure denominators, all analytic controls and full trailing replay.
search_proxies.omits: Additional final statistical seed, 1024-coalition budget, extra final queries/repetitions, reserved German half and NY2024 examples. Search is development evidence, not publication confirmation.

search_proxies.name: draft_smoke_workload
search_proxies.preserves: Same loading/imports/native-or-broker interface, safe model update/assembly, actual weighted solve, controls, fixed aggregation and output schemas, all five case types plus trailing replay.

search_visible: Canonical research question, permitted starter literature, search-only dataset/version and feature-schema descriptions, candidate interface and edit boundary, plane-independent workload fields, common model/estimand definitions, allowed resource ceilings, and the fixed search score/eligibility/tie policy; never final seed constants or seed-to-workload mappings.

After each of at most three campaign candidate evaluations, the exact search metrics.json scalars and sanitized search correctness/failure diagnostics may guide the next idea cycle. No final results or evaluator-private targets, per-instance reference vectors, baseline outputs, private scoring records, or resource paths are returned through candidate RPC.

During an episode the isolated candidate receives only the permitted model/preprocessing parameters, feature background, query features, and seed-independent workload settings. Reset seeds initialize random streams; request contents and operation sequence, not seed identity, specify workload. Every control obeys this same boundary.
final_sealed: Final seeds and complete manifests, reserved German and New York records, raw-content audit details identifying held-out rows, evaluator targets, reference attributions, baseline outputs, analytic answers, per-instance metrics, failures, and all final scoring evidence stay private during search and candidate selection.

After source/configuration freeze, final execution reveals only the per-episode permitted model weights, background features, and query features necessary for explanations. Final metrics and evidence are sealed from the optimizer and candidate; release to the scientific reporting/publication workflow only after final evaluation closes, with no further candidate tuning or selection.

Trusted broker transcript, resource accounting, allocation attestation, and evaluator-private correctness evidence are not candidate feedback. The supported candidate API remains handle(request); do not invent candidate memory or telemetry accessors or expose host paths.

required_evidence: A complete paper, PDF plus LaTeX sources, using the latest available official NeurIPS main-conference template at scaffold/report preparation, with the applicable main-text page limit and required checklist verified from official instructions and the exact template release archived. Include abstract, introduction, related work, method, experiments, uncertainty, discussion, limitations, references, and truthful failures. Verify the latest template rather than assuming an old release is current. A reporting workflow outside the frozen candidate converts evaluator-owned completed-run evidence into tables/figures; sealed targets/results are never sent back to candidate code to write the paper.

All code, exact environment/runtime versions, offline-installable dependency provenance, public-data acquisition instructions, verified folktables commit/license, Census terms, dataset release/download hashes, raw-normalization rules, normalized-content group hashes, source IDs and row provenance, split seeds/manifests, commands, and measured versus estimated timing. Demonstrate zero normalized raw predictor-content overlap between every search and final data role before preprocessing; different IDs, directories, or states are insufficient. Shared immutable code/model weights are not examples and need not be duplicated as data. These are downstream evidence obligations, not claims that hashes or completed captures already exist.

Frozen method/source identity establishing execution of genuine Kernel SHAP, not aliases; evaluator-owned training settings, convergence diagnostics, model quality on private labels, background selection, original-feature grouping, interventional semantics, output scale, safe model-serialization equivalence, library/regularization settings, real coalition budgets and fixed episode manifests. Clarify that attribution repeatability and reference agreement do not establish causal correctness or model usefulness.

Production-shape serialized-payload preflight covering largest complete requests and responses, UTF-8 JSON, base64 expansion, metadata, envelope, escaping, and framing; strict sub-64-MiB assertions, the smaller application cap, bounded candidate-memory chunk assembly, and exact complete RPC budgets including every chunk/reset/control/replay call. Include global production and smoke reset transcripts matching their declared arrays, one reset per episode, no interleaved replay, and complete invocation-wide aggregation. Failed protocol coverage cannot be disguised as a successful smaller run.

Offline empty-HOME smoke for both independent evaluators under the same declared CPU role topology, with preserved loading, update, candidate RPC, controls, and metric paths; phase timing and preflight checks used for bounded feasibility calibration. Full production logs are separately required to assert full-workload completion. Trusted wall/CPU/RPC enforcement must be distinguished from advisory candidate-internal operation/iteration budgets; no unsupported hard internal-compute-cap or perfectly matched candidate-operation-count claim. Harness-owned allocation/accounting evidence, not invented candidate telemetry, supports resource statements.

Actual complete primary search and final experimental tables, matched baseline and control results, instance-level repeated attribution data sufficient for reproduction, reference convergence/error bounds, fixed finite worst-case contributions for every missing/failed case, and all scheduled denominators and hierarchy weights. Include evaluator-owned constant, analytic additive, copy, informative nonidentity permutation, and reset-replay expectations/results. Show copy-based apparent stability does not pass reference validity and reject vacuous permutations. Never suppress failed baselines, missing controls, unfavorable cells, or incomplete experiments.

Preregistered practical agreement criteria and confidence interpretation, deterministic ranking/eligibility/tie/freezing policy, disjoint seeds, paired budget/model/dataset comparisons with directions and uncertainty, and an explicit separation of scientific validity, search.correct, final.correct, and final claim support. Positive, conditional, negative, and uncertain results are equally reportable. Comparative search thresholds cannot be added during drafting when task.md delegates none. Every asserted advantage must have its relevant real baseline, fair budget accounting, and complete uncertainty evidence; an unresolved approximate reference bounds what can be claimed.

Run-derived provenance for every paper number, table, and figure and its generating script, including complete source/artifact hashes and explicit labels for uncompleted work. No fabricated measurements, placeholder numerical findings, invented literature, or inferred successful launches. Select and inspect allowed starter literature directly and record what was actually read. Do not search for, identify, access, use, or indirectly follow discussions/citations of the prohibited prior paper; use a conservative allowed-source acquisition plan and stop reading immediately on accidental exposure, documenting URL, circumstances, and extent in reproduction notes. No novelty assertion relies on discovering that paper.

Campaign accounting showing at most three idea cycles and one candidate evaluation per cycle, no hidden extra search evaluations, one frozen final evaluation, CPU-first execution within the one-week calendar envelope and approximately 24 CPU-hour plan, and captured data/results under a few GB. If required sources, controls, dependencies, baseline runs, or substantive final workloads cannot be completed, state the limitation or failed design/run explicitly rather than claiming the planned evidence exists.
